newsitem.title: USA: CKE sees 25-30 new openings in 1997.
newsitem.headline: CKE sees 25-30 new openings in 1997.

text.p: CKE Restaurants Inc president Tom Thompson said the company plans to open between 25 and 30 new restaurants next year.

The Anaheim, California-based company, which operates the Carl's Jr. line of restaurants, told investors at a Robertson Stephens conference here the the company opened seven restaurants last year and will open between 15 and 17 new restaurants this year.

CKE also said same-store sales have been rising, which it attributed to new acquisitions, targeting to the Hispanic community, and a new advertising campaign. One of the television ads features basketball star Dennis Rodman having his burger stolen by one of his many tattoos.
CKE also said it currently has a 15 percent stake in Rally's Hamburgers Inc.
